facts.text: The hotel is housed in the Palácio das Cardosas, an 18th-century building.
facts.excerpt: Instalado no Palácio das Cardosas, um edifício do século XVIII

facts.text: The hotel overlooks Avenida dos Aliados in the heart of Porto.
facts.excerpt: tem vista sobre a Avenida dos Aliados, no coração do Porto

facts.text: São Bento Station, the Clérigos Tower, Livraria Lello and the Ribeira are a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A Estação de São Bento, a Torre dos Clérigos, a Livraria Lello e a Ribeira ficam a poucos minutos a pé.

facts.text: The hotel faces Praça da Liberdade, Porto's Belle Époque main square.
facts.excerpt: facing out onto Praça da Liberdade, Porto’s elegant Belle Époque main square

facts.text: The lobby has crystal chandeliers and marble floors.
facts.excerpt: Light from the crystal chandeliers bounces off the lobby's staid marble floors

facts.text: Rooms have a clean, contemporary look, with detailed crown molding and ceiling-height mirrors hinting at the building's history.
facts.excerpt: with a clean, contemporary aesthetic, and a history only narrowly hinted at by detailed crown molding and ceiling-height mirrors

facts.text: Deluxe rooms overlook the Pátio das Cardosas, a quiet pedestrian square.
facts.excerpt: vista para o Patio das Cardosas, uma praça pedonal muito sossegada e moderna

facts.text: Deluxe rooms have full marble bathrooms with both a bathtub and a shower.
facts.excerpt: Casa de banho completa em mármore, com banheira e chuveiro.

facts.text: Classic rooms may include a city-centre view or a cathedral view.
facts.excerpt: City Center View, Vista da catedral

facts.text: The wellness centre offers massages and sauna sessions.
facts.excerpt: Desde massagens calmantes a sessões de sauna revigorantes

facts.text: The concierge team offers a curated guide to a perfect day in Porto, with local insights and hidden gems.
